method_summary: Existing hero assets re-verified byte-for-byte against ground-truth receipts. Missing canvas screenshots produced by running the real n8n package (npm install, isolated SQLite instance) in a git worktree, importing the actual 3 registry-listed workflow JSON files via n8n's built-in 'Import from URL' feature (served from a local static file server over the worktree's own workflows/ directory), and capturing real editor-canvas screenshots via PinchTab against a locally-launched Chrome bridge instance. No image was fabricated or hand-drawn; every pixel is a real render of real repo content by the real tool.

gap_produced.encode_convention_note: PNG chosen for static UI/canvas screenshots (matches pinchgrab's noodle-festival-card.png / chrome-web-store-badge.png and orb_forge's preset-gallery.png house convention of PNG-for-static, WebP-for-looping-motion; this repo's own install-demo.webp is the looping-motion case, left untouched).
gap_produced.capture_pipeline_correction: PinchTab's `screenshot` command defaults to JPEG regardless of the -o file's extension (confirmed via `pinchtab screenshot --help`: --format defaults to jpeg; the sibling skill doc's 'format by extension' claim does not hold for this deployed version). Initial captures were written as .png-named files that were actually JPEG bytes (caught via `file`, not trusted on extension alone). Re-encoded losslessly into true PNG containers via `ffmpeg -i in.jpeg out.png` — same captured pixels, no re-render, no re-crop, no additional lossy step; only the container/magic-bytes now match the .png extension. Final dimensions 1280x657.

cross_check: Node counts (5/5/8) independently recomputed via python3 json.load(...)['nodes'] length against the worktree's actual checked-in JSON, matching both the ground-truth receipts table and the visible node count in each captured screenshot.
